verdict.line: You lose if Fiora hits four Riposte-safe procs before level 6 and outscales your all-in; you win if you survive to 6 and force siege duels she can't Vital-farm around.

brief.thesis: Fiora's W (Riposte) parries your single-target trigger (Q Obliterate detonation or an auto) for free sustain and a slow, so short-trade poking is a trap until you can layer damage she can't parry away in one button. Mordekaiser's actual win condition is forcing extended trades and side-lane 1v9 siege pressure where her Vitals require exposure she won't get if you shove and back off the wave.

theirWindow.when: Riposte off cooldown, she's above 4 Vital stacks
theirWindow.what: She will bait a stray auto or your Q reset to parry, healing and slowing you into a follow-up combo. Do not throw single instances of burst at her when W is up — trade with sustained pressure (autos plus DoT ticks) instead of one committed hit.

yourWindow.when: Riposte on cooldown or she's just used it
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Land Q (Obliterate) for the mark, follow with W (Siphon of Destruction) sweep and autos, and commit fully — she has no answer to sustained damage without her parry.

runes.keystoneWhy: rewards the sustained-trade playstyle this matchup demands and gives free HP/damage scaling for extended duels instead of the burst trades Riposte punishes

summoners.why: Ignite shuts down her healing from Riposte procs and life steal items during all-ins; Teleport lets you reset after losing early trades and still show up for sieges once you hit your power spike at 9-13

playing.title: Never trade into up Riposte
playing.detail: Check her W cooldown before every extended exchange. If it's up, only poke with things that don't matter if parried — otherwise wait it out.

playing.title: All-in the instant W is down
playing.detail: The moment she uses Riposte on a minion, ward, or your bait, commit fully with Q into W into autos. This is your highest-value window all game.

playing.title: Bait Riposte with a throwaway ability
playing.detail: Flash a Q or an auto she'll want to parry, let her burn W on it, then punish with your real combo.

playing.title: Track her ult (Grand Challenge) stacks
playing.detail: Her true damage and lifesteal ramp up on extended solo fights. Don't let duels go past 4-5 seconds once she's built lifesteal items — burst the trade or disengage.

playing.title: Prioritize siege over skirmish
playing.detail: Shove waves into turret and threaten with R (Children of the Grave) rather than dueling in open lane, since she thrives on isolated 1v1s with room to maneuver.

playing.title: Use ghost form to reset losing trades
playing.detail: If your R triggers from a losing fight, the ghost persists — you can still secure the kill or safely disengage even if your body is dying.

playing.title: Play for scaling, not lane kills
playing.detail: You don't need to win lane outright. Survive to your item spikes around level 9-13 where sustained damage and tankiness make you the stronger duelist regardless of her CS lead.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect the standard tank/bruiser Mordekaiser build as of my last training data (mid-2025 era); verify Sunfire Aegis, Abyssal Mask, Thornmail, and the Resolve tree layout haven't been renamed or reworked on patch 16.18.1, and double check Fiora's current W (Riposte) parry window and ultimate stack mechanics haven't changed.
